newsitem.title: GERMANY: German institutes say interest rates may rise.
newsitem.headline: German institutes say interest rates may rise.

text.p: Germany's six leading economic research institutes said on Tuesday that the current level of interest rates is appropriate, but that a slight tightening is possible if M3 money supply growth remains above target levels.
"At present neither interest rate cuts nor rises appear necessary," the institutes said in a report to be released later on Tuesday, a copy of which was obtained by Reuteres.

But the Bundesbank should not hesitate to raise interest rates slightly if M3 remains above target. A slight tightening to bring M3 back into the target corridor would pose no danger of ending the economic upturn, the report said.
